primary_metric: For each group b0..5,6..14,15..29 and input bit k=0..4, form one-bit edges (b,b xor 2^k) where both legal b are in same group and low endpoint has bit k=0. Across four models * six anchors for r2, report aligned (predicted 2nd output bit k:0->1), reversed (1->0), unchanged, invalid, per-bit and per model; signed alignment=aligned-reversed. Compare negative-control r1 first-output changes across same edges (should be unchanged).
secondary_metric: Second-word aggregate bit accuracy per group and majority-bit baseline per group; token exact retained from PR34. Report 24 contexts separately; do not interpret 24 repeated contexts as independent trained networks. No fresh NN logits.
prior_interpretation: PR34 reports 1/216 and 0/360 exact r2 for novel answer-bearing b. This analysis tests whether some b-bit change is reflected in output despite failure of entire word.
decision_gate: Do not claim transferable copy unless positive aligned excess is robust across independent seeds AND model modes; otherwise describe observed bit-level dependence and limits. No statistical significance claims from correlated edge counts.
